open_items: ILO healthy -> provider_down at cycle 1114 (2026-10-26T00:01Z): all five checks failing with HTTP 403, confirmed live as a Cloudflare edge block (server: cloudflare, __cf_bm cookie), not a gateway-side bug. New as of this cycle; ILO's two prior flaps (cycle 1102, 1108) were partial degraded states that recovered in one cycle. This one is full provider_down including the gateway path. Watch next cycle: recovery means transient Cloudflare challenge, persistence past 2-3 cycles means escalate like SBS.

SBS provider_down continuously from cycle 1107 (2026-10-25T10:01Z) through cycle 1114 (2026-10-26T00:01Z): 8 consecutive cycles, 16 hours, no recovery. Error signature shifted from DNS resolution failure (cycles 1107-1112) to ConnectTimeout (cycles 1113-1114). Live recheck this run got past this session's proxy (CONNECT succeeded, unlike the 502 policy denial on the last two runs) but the TLS handshake to data-sdmx-disseminate.sbs.gov.ws reset after ~13s, consistent with the monitor's own ConnectTimeout shift and confirming this is provider-side, not our network policy. Already past the previous run's real-outage threshold. Re-escalate if it passes 24h (around cycle 1119, 2026-10-26T10:01Z).

ILO degraded at cycle 1102 (direct metadata+json 403) and cycle 1108 (direct metadata 503): both resolved within one cycle, already reported in their own entries. Superseded by the cycle 1114 provider_down entry above; re-open only if cycle 1114 also turns out to be a one-cycle blip, otherwise fold into the new incident.

ESTAT gateway metadata latency flap resolved as predicted: climbed 48134ms (cycle 1102) -> 48573ms (1105) -> 52965ms (1108) -> 55119ms (1111), then crossed the 60s deadline at cycle 1113 (gateway_issue, list_dataflows timed out), then recovered at cycle 1114 to 5018ms on a successful retry (attempts=2). Treated as the known 'ESTAT under load' flap, working as designed; not re-alerted. Watch for a repeat climb.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1114: listing served without credentials. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
96 claude/ triage branches on origin as of last fetch, same count as last run. Still above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all; currently moot while ILO is provider_down); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
